name: UK strikes & disruption
summary: Consultants in England strike 25–26 Nov; RMT calls Tube driver strikes from 26 Nov
state: Consultant doctors in England will strike on 25 and 26 Nov, the BMA announced on 26 Oct (NHS Employers). The RMT announced eight 24-hour London Underground strikes by drivers from 26 Nov to February (Share Talk). These are strikes in single sectors, within the Watch band, and no national infrastructure failure had been reported as of 6 Nov.
for_you: Patients will be contacted if planned NHS care is affected; NHS 111 and A&E remain open. London commuters should check TfL for service changes on strike days.
rubric_hit: Watch: national strike in one sector (consultants, 25–26 Nov); not multiple simultaneous national strikes

sources.title: NHS Employers — Consultant doctors announce strikes in November

why: Strikes and infrastructure failures in rail, health, ports and power disrupt daily life and the economy.
drivers: Pay disputes, infrastructure failures, cyber incidents, weather.

rubric.alert: Multiple simultaneous national strikes, or nationwide infrastructure failure.
rubric.watch: National strike in one sector or major infrastructure disruption.
rubric.normal: No national-scale strikes or disruption this week.
